opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based institutions with a formal employment relationship between the applicant and the host organisation. Excludes individuals without such a relationship, schools or further‑education colleges, undergraduates or master’s students, PhD fee funding, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, local charities, and projects led by organisations not based in the UK (except in exceptional cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research that addresses one or more of the five priority questions set out in the Nuffield Foundation Strategic Review, with up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) available per grant. Two annual deadlines (Spring and Autumn) with the next outline deadline on 5 Oct 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based researchers and organisations, with a strong encouragement for applicants from racially minoritised communities and partnership projects that involve those communities. Applicants should have a formal relationship with a UK host institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges. The 2026 priority theme is “Inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK”. Grants range from £15k to £500k, with the next deadline on 5 Oct 2026.
